_readme: Winner -> official handle per network. A handle is used ONLY when verified is true: a human (CoS/GTM) opened the account, saw the platform's verified badge or the brand's own site linking to it, and set verified=true, checked=YYYY-MM-DD, by=<who>. Unknown or unverified winners post with no tag. sensitive=true withholds the post entirely (politics, tragedy, minors, private individuals). Never add an entry to chase a bigger account; the verdict comes first.
